text:
Exposing corruption in the Pardon System isn't enough. We have to do something about it.
 
That's why I'm working with my colleague, Congressman Jason Crow, to introduce the Abuse of the Pardon Prevention Act.
 
Our legislation would require independent investigations into pardons involving potential conflicts of interest, strengthen congressional oversight, make clear that trading pardons for bribes is a crime, prohibit presidents from pardoning themselves, and require financial disclosures when pardon recipients make contributions benefiting the president.
 
The American people deserve to know whether money and political connections are influencing who receives a presidential pardon.
 
The pardon power was created to be an instrument of justice and mercy, NOT a way for wealthy donors and political insiders to buy their way out of accountability.
 
And these safeguards should apply to EVERY president, Democrat or Republican.
 
No one should ever be able to buy a presidential pardon. Period.
 
And don't worry, the Pardon Papers aren't going anywhere. I'll continue exposing the questionable deals and conflicts of interest surrounding Trump's pardons.
 
But we're also taking action to make sure no president can abuse this power without accountability.
 
Watch Episode 17 of the Pardon Papers now.
